summary_claims.claim: Fines follow AI Act ceilings and add up to EUR 1 million or 0.5% of worldwide turnover for breaches of Articles 27 and 86. Literal translation: 'is subject to an administrative fine of up to EUR 1,000,000 or, if higher, up to 0.5 per cent of total worldwide annual turnover.'
Employers must leave final decisions on the employment relationship to a person; ACN is competent for national registration of Annex III point 2 systems; Art. 52 trade secrets
